protocol: Ground-level oxygen prebreathe, then chamber exposure while breathing air. Ascent and descent at 5000 ft/min, with 10 minutes at 25,000 ft.
outcome_window: First joint and headache symptoms 20 minutes after descent. Vestibular symptoms began 3.5 hours after descent.
locator: Printed pp. 1106–1108, Case Report and Figures 1–3
note: One case report. The 1997 abstract and 1999 journal article describe the same episode. It predates the 2015–2022 IAF series.
